summary: Retained ObjectGenome generation-8 validates an affordance center against its referenced component bounds but accepts any positive finite affordance.radiusM, with no relationship to the component or object envelope. A normal one-meter object can therefore carry a canonical grip/push/pull/sit/open/close interaction region with an astronomically large finite radius. This is distinct from the already-owned recipe cardinality/text-budget work because one constant-size numeric scalar is sufficient to create the malformed physical interaction envelope.
evidence: Inspected retained, independently source/test-approved ObjectGenome PR #395 exact head ebfd17e7a2d5cf2083b90e0122b70bc5c39d0962 and its contract documentation.

ObjectGenome.inspect() proves affordance.localPointM is a finite Vec3 and, when the referenced component is valid, rejects a point outside half component dimensions plus BOUNDS_TOLERANCE_M. Immediately afterward radiusM is checked only by isPositiveFinite(); there is no component-relative or object-relative upper envelope.
Docs/OBJECT_GENOME.md defines affordances as stable physical interaction/grip regions on components using a local point and radius, so radius is physical-domain semantics rather than opaque metadata.

An oversized radius does not require an oversized collection, deep graph, long string, or large retained text payload. The existing proposed HG-BACKFILL-OBJECTGENOME-STATE-BOUNDS lane and today's recipe-cardinality/recipe-text findings therefore do not close this numeric physical-scale hole.

Repository PR/issue screening for ObjectGenome affordance-radius/numeric-bound work found no current or historical repair owner for this exact surface. Existing #395 work targets decoder exact shape/no-execute and the blocked state-bounds leaf targets traversal/cardinality.
This is source-only contract analysis; no Roblox Studio interaction-distance test, engine timing, viewport, physical-contact, or two-client evidence is claimed.

metadata.recommendedNext: After retained #395 and trusted ownership unblock ObjectGenome source work, add a narrow physical-affordance invariant (or fold it into the next ObjectGenome physical-scale leaf): define a documented project-owned maximum interaction radius relative to the referenced component/object envelope, reject finite over-envelope radii before ownership/fingerprint retention, and add exact-bound/+epsilon or representative over-bound regressions. Preserve normal fixture radii and v1 stable identity inputs; if existing published v1 content relies on radii outside the chosen relationship, make that compatibility/versioning decision explicit rather than silently clamping.
